profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I’m a  Software Engineer with experience in collaborating and making decisions with leaders, designers, and project managers.  I like to work with both users and leadership to understand the core of problems and come up with solutions that are within budget and scope.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Manager of all things of the marketing website including implementation of a/b tests, overall design system and continued scalability for enterprise serving company.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Designer and developer of the first initial alpha of a software as a service educational app making the feedback loop faster. This project has branched from a side project to a full on web app with over 100,000+ users.

positions.title: Co-Owner & Web Developer
positions.description: Cofounder and technical director for 5+ years at a worker-owned cooperative creative agency. As a cofounder I have played a number of different roles in project management, governance, and human resources in addition to consulting and technically advising clients and designers.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Lead Developer on a small team of student employees that worked on a number of different in house as well as campus wide applications for student life.

volunteerExperiences.description: I served as a teacher aid to my chinese teacher during summer camps as well as volunteered around their main office also as a small group leader for high school students.
